items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Deepens Quantum Push With New Research And Commercial Ties
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) expanded its quantum computing work through new and extended partnerships with PsiQuantum, IBM and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
